, by quantizing global model updates, the communication cost of the FL system can be significantly reduced, while the accuracy of the global model is only marginally affected.

the proposed L FL scheme is a promising approach for reducing the communication cost of the global model transmission in the PS-to-device link, which can be a bottleneck for the communication efficiency of the overall FL system.
